# Laguna View Detox

> Laguna View Detox is a licensed, private residential drug and alcohol detox and treatment center in Laguna Beach, California, offering medically supervised detox, residential inpatient care, dual diagnosis treatment and aftercare planning.

Address: 31305 Ceanothus Dr, Laguna Beach, CA 92651. Admissions phone: (866) 932-3206 (24/7). Email: info@lagunaviewdetox.com. Licensed by the California Department of Health Care Services (DHCS License #300024AP).

Content on this site is general information, not medical advice. In an emergency call 911; for a mental health or substance use crisis, call or text 988.
